clips.title: The story
paras: At Brill, Apothecary Johaan offers a drink with a deadly purpose. Disguised as a common refreshment, it tests the Royal Apothecary Society’s developing plague.

In Brill, Apothecary Johaan prepares a brew from venomous components and local reagents. Though it looks like a tavern drink, the mixture is made to test how virulent the plague is against living beings. Johaan hands it over as if to quench a captive’s thirst. The work serves the Forsaken apothecaries’ effort to create a weapon potent enough to fulfill Sylvanas Windrunner’s designs for Azeroth.
